ValidationRule.description: 1. NA users cannot assign case to JP users / queues and vice-versa
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( AND( NOT(BEGINS(OwnerId,"00G")), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), TEXT(Owner:User.Country_Code__c) = "US", TEXT(Owner:User.Country_Code__c) <> TEXT(Country_Code__c) ) ,
AND(ISCHANGED(OwnerId), BEGINS(OwnerId,'00G'), BEGINS( Owner:Queue.QueueName ,'CCNA'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "US"))) , AND(ISCHANGED(OwnerId), BEGINS(OwnerId,'00G'), NOT(BEGINS( Owner:Queue.QueueName ,'CCNA')), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "US")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Queue/User selected does not belong to your country. Please select another.
